title: The Emperor goes on bringing the ports under the crown's direct control and adopts the reform Harbor Administration, to be fully in force in 649 days: one more naval governor, a steady drift of the realm toward the sea, and in every coastal location a fifth less proximity cost through the port and a tenth faster growth

data.flavour: Port facilities must be efficiently managed to support maritime trade and naval operations. Corruption will be reduced, and commerce will thrive under structured supervision.
data.replaces: Autocracy: the crown gives up some power elsewhere to bring the ports under its control (Trent; the autosave of 1 February 1447 lists Harbor Administration in force and Autocracy gone)
